body.message:
The unit is located on the 15th floor.

You may proceed with monthly payments, to be completed before the end of each current month. The extension will commence accordingly. As confirmed, the rate will be AED 5,000 per month for the first three months, and AED 6,000 per month for the subsequent three months.

The security deposit is fully refundable and will be reimbursed within 14 working days after check-out, subject to a property inspection. The refund will be processed via credit card or bank transfer. However, we will make every effort to expedite the process and aim to complete the refund within 7 working days.

You will have access to all amenities. The reservation confirmation will be shared once the payment has been completed.

My name is Tharushi - reservations coordinator
